title: CompVLA: A Variable Compliance Vision-Language-Action Model for Contact-rich Manipulation
total_params: Not stated in the sections opened for this card.
paradigm: Variable-compliance VLA. The local note says Kp and Kd plus actions. The paper's learned compliance outputs are diagonal stiffness and virtual displacement.
hardware_fit: Local note: ideal stack-on, about 3–4 GB VRAM

parts.observation_encoder: pi0 / PaliGemma vision-language backbone, initialized from lerobot/pi0_base.
parts.language_or_goal: A language or goal conditioning channel was not recorded in the sections opened for this card.
parts.memory: A chunk of T=25. No test-time memory beyond that chunk was described.
parts.action_representation: Flow matching. The action expert emits TCP twist and gripper. The compliance expert emits diagonal stiffness and virtual displacement.
parts.controller: Geometric impedance. The virtual target is the reference pose deformed by d. Only Kd is learned.
parts.objective: Joint flow matching on the action sequence and the compliance sequence.

title: World Action Models are Zero-shot Policies
total_params: 14B for the Wan2.1-I2V-14B runs. A 5B Wan ablation is also reported. Added parameters are the state and action encoder/decoder.
paradigm: Joint video-action diffusion, a 14B world-action model
hardware_fit: Local note: not recommended, about 40–80+ GB. The paper's speed table uses H100 and GB200.

parts.observation_encoder: Frozen VAE, image encoder, and text encoder in front of a Wan video DiT. The paper's main run is Wan2.1-I2V-14B.
parts.language_or_goal: A frozen text encoder over the task prompt.
parts.memory: A causal KV cache. After each chunk the predicted frame is replaced by the real observation.
parts.action_representation: Action registers inside the same DiT that denoises video latents.
parts.controller: Execute the decoded relative joint chunk. The paper's optimized inference is about 7 Hz.
parts.objective: One weighted MSE on the video velocity and the action velocity.

title: microVLA: minimal VLA training and inference on a 4 GB laptop GPU
total_params: 10.5M total: vision 1.9M, prefix 5.7M, action expert 2.3M. parameter_counts() was not executed in this pass.
paradigm: Local note: distilled vision, static text lookup, and a chunk head. This repository is a pi0.5-style ViT plus flow-matching action expert.
hardware_fit: Local note: ideal baseline, about 2–3 GB VRAM. The README's small-model timing is 79 ms per chunk.

parts.observation_encoder: Shared 4-layer ViT, width 192, patch 8, then a linear map into the prefix.
parts.language_or_goal: Whitespace tokenizer over the task string, embedded with the discretized state.
parts.memory: A prefix KV cache for one chunk. No state is carried into the next replan.
parts.action_representation: Flow matching over a 16 by 7 chunk. Euler sampling defaults to 10 steps.
parts.controller: Unnormalize the chunk, clamp to [-1, 1], and execute the first 5 actions.
parts.objective: 1,000 steps of SigLIP cosine-plus-MSE, then 8,000 steps of flow-matching MSE.

title: pi0.7: a Steerable Generalist Robotic Foundation Model with Emergent Capabilities
total_params: About 5B: Gemma3 4B VLM (400M of that is the vision encoder) and an 860M action expert. The subgoal world model is a separate BAGEL 14B.
paradigm: Steerable VLA plus a subgoal world model
hardware_fit: Local note: scaled-down expert via cached VLM features. The paper's full model is about 5B, and the subgoal model is a separate 14B.

parts.observation_encoder: Gemma3 vision encoder, 400M of the 4B VLM, plus a MEM history encoder.
parts.language_or_goal: Detailed language, episode metadata, a control-modality label, and multi-view subgoal images from a separate model.
parts.memory: MEM temporal and spatial compression to a fixed token count.
parts.controller: Execute a shorter prefix of the predicted chunk. The control modality is context, not a learned impedance law.
parts.objective: A flow-matching lower bound on the steerable chunk likelihood, plus conditional flow matching for the subgoal image.

title: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
total_params: Original DiT 538M. Each TTT layer adds about 10M. DiT plus TTT is 690M. The Eagle VLM is extra and its parameter count was not extracted.
hardware_fit: Local note: ideal stack-on, about 4–5 GB VRAM. The paper's pretraining used 16 GB200 GPUs.

parts.observation_encoder: GR00T N1.7 Eagle VLM. The VLM size was not extracted.
parts.language_or_goal: One instruction shared across the trajectory.
parts.memory: A two-layer GeLU MLP whose fast weights are the memory, updated by an MSE bind after attention in each of 16 DiT layers.
parts.action_representation: Flow matching with an independent noise time on each action chunk.
parts.controller: The paper deploys the chunk on the YAM at 30 Hz. The number of actions executed before a replan was not extracted.
parts.objective: Outer flow-matching loss, plus the inner MSE that writes the fast weights. TBPTT cuts the backward pass at the segment boundary.

title: SuperMimic: Scaling Humanoid Whole-Body Control with One Differentiable World Model
total_params: 18,816,634 on the GenCoord G1 run: dynamics 8,745,346, sim context 66, actor 9,839,797, critic 231,425.
paradigm: Differentiable world model and short-horizon BPTT
hardware_fit: Local note: ideal online RL, about 6–8 GB VRAM. The paper's reported runs use H100 80 GB.

parts.observation_encoder: The representation's state vector, normalized, concatenated with the processed action and the sim context.
parts.language_or_goal: A reference motion clip. The actor has a per-task encoder.
parts.memory: Short imagined rollout. The world model is unrolled 8 steps on logged actions and 32 steps for the policy.
parts.action_representation: A per-task encoder to a 32-d tanh latent and a shared decoder.
parts.controller: The policy action is applied in MuJoCo Warp. No learned compliance controller was described.
parts.objective: Fit the world model on 8-step windows, then ascend the imagined return through 32 frozen steps. A critic regresses the return.
